question: Which compounds bind the protein encoded by PTGS2, and how strongly?
raw: PTGS2 encodes Prostaglandin G/H synthase 2, and 2,008 compounds bind it according to Pharos target-gene mapping and ligand activity [1–20]. The top compounds by pChEMBL IC50 are 3-(4-fluorophenyl)-2-(4-methylsulfonylphenyl)-1H-indole, 3-(4-methoxyphenyl)-2-(4-methylsulfonylphenyl)-1H-indole, and 4-(5-methyl-3-phenyl-1H-indol-2-yl)benzenesulfonamide, each at 10.7 [1–3]. Additional potent binders include compounds with activities of 10.2, 10.1, 9.92, 9.85, 9.77, 9.74, 9.7, 9.6, 9.55, 9.52, 9.44, 9.43, and 9.4 [4–20]. All activity values are experimental IC50 measurements on the pChEMBL scale, indicating 1 µM or stronger potency [1–20]. The lines do not show statistical, text-mined, or predicted data; they present curated and measured support only [1–20].
